item.description:
In Discussion

Breast Care Center

We are in discussions with the Breast Care center for two different BRIDGE dashboards. One for patient-reported outcomes and the other for connecting to and integrating with the Breast Care Center research patient registry: Athena.

Epilepsy

We are in discusssions with the Epilepsy clinic to create a dashboard that would bring in patient generated seizure data, MRIs and monitoring data.

Primary Care

We are working with Ida Sim in primary care on her AHRQ grant focused on patient-reported outcomes (PROs) collected through the mPROVE application. We will be working on developing a dashboard to bring mPROVE PROs to BRIDGE.

Traumatic Brain Injury

We are working with the Traumatic Brain Injury clinic to design and specify a dashboard for their clinical workflow.
